newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cossack still on red alert-Woodside.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cossack still on red alert-Woodside.

text.p: The Cossack oil field was still on "red alert" as developments with a tropical depression offshore Western Australia were monitored, operator Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Friday.
The Cossack-Pioneer offshore oil platform was still connected to its mooring, a company spokesman said.
If the tropical depression dissipated the field would resume production. If not the platform would be disconnected and moved away, he said, noting that cyclones were unpredictable.
It was possible that the field could resume production later on Friday if the tropical depression dissipated, he said.
